classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: Divine spellcaster with armor, healing, and the ability to turn undead. XP rows below are a partial transcription, not an automatic level award.
guidance: Requires Wisdom 9; some multiclass qualifications differ.
Check spell slots, Wisdom bonus spells, and turning ability for the new level.
After level 9, gain 2 hp per level instead of another hit die.
Level 8 followers require a qualifying place of worship; level 9 opens the stronghold option.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments
Complete spell-slot and spell-access delta

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A nature-focused cleric subclass with its own spells and a limited upper-level hierarchy. The PHB XP table is transcribed; rank advancement still has additional conditions.
guidance: Requires Wisdom 12 and Charisma 15; alignment is true neutral.
Level 3 adds identification, passage through overgrowth, and a new language; further levels add languages.
Level 7 adds immunity to charm from woodland-associated creatures and limited shapechanging.
Ranks 12–14 depend on vacancies or winning the specified challenge, as well as XP.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments
Complete spell-slot and spell-access delta

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: The core martial class. PHB XP thresholds and source-supported level changes are available; unreadable mechanics remain explicit gaps.
guidance: Requires Strength 9 and Constitution 7.
Check the attacks-per-round table when reaching a new combat band.
After level 9, gain 3 hp per level instead of another hit die.
At level 9, establishing and clearing a freehold can attract men-at-arms and revenue.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: The PHB lawful-good fighter subclass. Keep this progression distinct from the UA cavalier-based revision.
guidance: Human only: Strength 12, Intelligence 9, Wisdom 13, Constitution 9, and Charisma 17 are required.
Level 3 adds turning at the ability of a level-1 cleric; level 4 permits calling a warhorse.
Clerical spell use begins at level 9; check the class spell table.
After level 9, gain 3 hp per level; XP does not remove alignment, tithe, or conduct requirements.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments
Complete spell-slot and spell-access delta
Complete turn-undead table delta

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A good-aligned fighter subclass skilled in tracking, scouting, and fighting giant-class enemies.
guidance: Requires Strength 13, Intelligence 13, Wisdom 14, and Constitution 14; alignment must remain good.
The first level starts with two hit dice, rather than one.
Druidic spells begin at level 8, and magic-user spells at level 9.
At level 10, check followers and new item use; after level 10, gain 2 hp per level.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments
Complete spell-slot and spell-access delta

classes.name: Magic-user
classes.description: An arcane spellcaster who learns and prepares spells from spellbooks. The PHB XP table is transcribed; individual progression mechanics remain incomplete.
guidance: Requires Intelligence 9 and Dexterity 6; Intelligence limits spell learning and access.
Check new spell slots and the spellbook needed for newly available spell levels.
After level 11, gain 1 hp per level instead of another hit die.
At level 11, enchanting items and inscribing magic scrolls become possible; a cleared stronghold is possible from level 12. Separate procedures apply.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta
Complete attack-matrix delta for every armor class
Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments
Complete spell-slot and spell-access delta

classes.name: Illusionist
classes.description: A magic-user subclass with its own spell list, item permissions, and advancement table.
guidance: Requires Intelligence 15 and Dexterity 16; high scores grant no XP bonus for this class.
Use the illusionist spell-slot table and spell list rather than the magic-user equivalents.
After level 10, gain 1 hp per level instead of another hit die.
At level 10 and above, the source permits manufacturing suitable magic items; separate procedures apply.

pendingMechanics: Complete saving-throw delta

classes.name: Thief
classes.description: A stealth and skill specialist. Advancement changes skill probabilities, with racial and Dexterity adjustments applied separately.
guidance: Requires Dexterity 9; Dexterity above 15 grants a 10% earned-XP bonus.
Update the thief-function table and relevant racial and Dexterity adjustments at each level.
Check backstab and language-reading milestones against the source tables.
At level 10, magical writings and eligible scrolls become usable, with a risk of misunderstanding.

Character-specific ability, race, equipment, and multiclass adjustments

classes.name: Assassin
classes.description: A thief subclass focused on assassination, disguise, and spying; higher guild ranks require more than an XP total.
guidance: Requires Strength 12, Intelligence 11, and Dexterity 12; high abilities grant no XP bonus.
Most thieving functions are performed two levels below assassin level; backstab is an exception.
At level 9 and above, Intelligence 15+ can permit additional alignment languages.
Advancing beyond level 13 requires defeating the current guild leader; level 15 has a further leadership challenge.

Printed source conflict: PHB p.19 lists assassin class limit 14, while PHB p.30 explicitly gives a 15th-level Grandfather of Assassins; the applicable cap requires a campaign ruling.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A martial discipline with open-hand combat, level-based abilities, and limited higher ranks. The PHB XP table is transcribed.
guidance: Verify the demanding entry requirements in the source before choosing this class.
Update armor class, open-hand combat, and special abilities; PHB p. 30 and DMG p. 74 disagree on the monk attack table, so confirm the campaign ruling.
Level 6 permits limited henchmen; level 8 begins the restricted higher ranks.
Level 8 and above requires a successful unarmed challenge for a rank, as well as sufficient XP.

sharedTableI.evidence: hitDie is stored/rendered for the ten PHB classes; spell ability, maximum hit-dice and full class-level-limit table are not stored as shared source-table rows in the current class records.

sharedTableII.evidence: No shared p.19 Table II class record, structured Table II fields or per-class row transcript was found in current classes.json/rules.json. Exact permitted-equipment values therefore cannot be found from class search; selected class prose reminders are partial.

thievingFunctionTable.evidence: Selected per-level thief skill deltas exist in classes.json; the complete 17-row base table, 7-row racial adjustment matrix, and p.28 interpretation/retry notes are not a single current class-view table.

assassinFeeTable.evidence: No PHB p.29 15-by-8 fee table data exists in the assassin class record or a PHB rule table. Assassin guidance has no exact fee lookup or victim bracket.

monkAbilityTable.evidence: Selected special ability and level-change prose exists in the monk record; the complete 17-rank six-column ability table and full A–K explanatory notes are not a structured table.

rangerTracking.evidence: The current ranger record has a mixture of PHB summary and separate UA-replacement tracking changes. The PHB p.24 underground/outdoor tracker procedure and its bounded modifiers are not a separate PHB source table; do not treat UA rules as a PHB pass.

dualClassAndMulticlass.evidence: Current rules records `dual-class` p.33 and `multiclass-equipment` p.32–33 exist; they remain summaries rather than complete source-prose reconciliation.
